notes: The page at rest for a guest: the title and the one action the page offers a visitor with no session. `origin` is the title, because the page's frame and the app's frame are different heights and the design is the gap between these boxes, not where the first one lands. `capture` is the action, because it is the region both clients draw identically. The title's width is left out deliberately - it is the run of the words, not a decision - and colours are left out too, because they are what the raster proves. The member's list states read the fixture account's own connections and are not part of this contract yet.

motion.notes: The connected-apps list is still. The destructive revoke control brightens on hover and shrinks 2% on press; the same means the same 150ms ease-out and the same press travel, with the colour change kept under reduced motion. Loading is a pulse skeleton.

entries.gesture: hover over, focus or press the revoke control
entries.moves: it brightens on hover and focus and shrinks 2% on press over 150ms
entries.same: the same 150ms ease-out, focus ring and 2% press travel; reduced motion keeps the colour change and drops the travel

entries.moves: a pulse skeleton holds the list height until the rows arrive
entries.same: the same pulse skeleton; reduced motion shows the settled list without the pulse
